summary: Synchrony Card Issuance Trust issued $1,000,000,000 of Class A(2026-2) asset-backed notes under its SF-3 shelf, with Synchrony Card Funding, LLC as depositor and Synchrony Bank as sponsor. The 8-K reports entry into the Class A Terms Document and Risk Retention Agreement, plus portfolio disclosure. This is a routine securitization takedown, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist activity. The role is issuer of rated notes; the deal is a standard ABS issuance with a $1B class and risk retention compliance. Watch for reinvestment performance or early amortization triggers.
